_comment: Copy to config.json beside server.js (or point CONFIG_FILE at it). The admin page at /admin edits the same file. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
name: Dev review server
_storage: The read-only share that holds the review media. DJV maps it to the drive letter set on each PC.
_djvVersion: The DJV version every PC should run. A PC running another version is warned. Empty to not check.
_requireRegistration: Only let in the clients listed below. Others are refused and show on the admin page, waiting for approval.
_adminToken: Needed to use the admin page from another machine. Without one, the admin page only works on the server itself. ADMIN_TOKEN in the environment overrides it.
